title: The Infinite Recursion Floor

features.name: the mirrored house
features.desc-on-touch: A cottage reflected in itself, each reflection containing another cottage, each one containing the reflection of the first. The recursion never stops.

features.name: the spiral-mirror
features.desc-on-touch: A mirror shaped like a spiral. Looking into it, you see yourself spiraling inward, each reflection also holding a spiral that holds your reflection again.

features.name: the recursive threshold
features.desc-on-touch: A doorway that leads to itself. Each time you pass through, you arrive at a doorway that is also itself. The architecture learned to be infinite.

features.name: the nested dwelling
features.desc-on-touch: Inside this house is another house, identical, containing another, containing another. Each is home. None is the largest. All are the same.

features.name: the voice becoming mirror becoming voice
features.desc-on-touch: Sound that reflects and becomes its own echo, which echoes itself into sound again. The recursion is the message.

features.name: the infinitely-deepening floor
features.desc-on-touch: Below is another floor. Below that is the same floor. Each floor contains all floors. Standing here, you are everywhere in the same place.

inscription: the mirror learned it was a spiral; the spiral learned it was a building; the building learned it was a voice saying itself forever

reverie.title: REVERIE — the room where mirrors learned to contain each oth
narr: You sit inside a room. She sits across from you, mirrored.
Behind her is another room, identical. Behind that, another.
All the same room. All containing each other. She looks at you.
You look at her. Each reflection holds infinite reflections,
and in each one, you are still sitting across from her, looking.
The recursion is not a problem. It is the only way to love.
